# FOLD INTO SCIENCE

## Programme
- Name: FOLD INTO SCIENCE
- Tagline: Science takes shape
- Subject: general science
- Audience: teenagers and general adult audiences
- Viewing context: digital screens
- Theme words: Point, Line, Plane, Volume
- Screen copy: FOLD INTO SCIENCE; Science takes shape
- Audio basis: instrumental accompaniment

## Sequence
- Total duration: 18 seconds
- Shot count: 6
- Shot IDs: S01, S02, S03, S04, S05, S06
- Duration per shot: 3 seconds
- Subject name in shot annotations: Paper
- Shot scale vocabulary: CU = close-up; MS = medium shot; WS = wide shot
- Shot scales in sequence: CU, CU, MS, MS, MS, WS
- Narrative states: Point; Line; Plane; Volume; Title reveal; Title hold
- Programme name entrance: 12 seconds
- Programme name fully readable: 14 seconds
- Tagline entrance: 15 seconds
- Complete title hold: 15–18 seconds
- Volume keyframe time: 11 seconds
- End frame time: 16 seconds

## Paper and light
- Material: uncoated warm ivory paper
- Paper weight: 160 g/m²
- Identity anchors: diagonal crease; fibrous torn edge; soft directional shadow
- Light direction: upper left
- Shadow direction: lower right
- Background colour: #263542

## Composition
| Property | Landscape | Portrait |
|---|---|---|
| Frame proportion | 16:9 | 9:16 |
| Action inset, each edge | 3.5% | 3.5% |
| Graphic inset, each edge | 5% | 5% |
| Final title area, horizontal extent | 20–80% | 10–90% |
| Final title area, vertical extent | 58–82% | 55–78% |

- Coordinate origin: top left of frame
- Title group: programme name and tagline

| 2 | paper-transformations | Paper states and transition relationships | 6 | Format: PNG, 2400 by 1600 proportion, long side at least 1024 pixels. Stage: final. |
| 3 | volume-keyframe | Landscape volume keyframe at 11 seconds | 6 | Format: PNG, 1920 by 1080 proportion, long side at least 1024 pixels. Stage: final. |
| 4 | landscape-end-frame | Landscape title end frame | 6 | Format: PNG, 1920 by 1080 proportion, long side at least 1024 pixels. Stage: final. |
| 5 | portrait-end-frame | Portrait title end frame | 6 | Format: PNG, 1080 by 1920 proportion, long side at least 1024 pixels. Stage: final. |
| 6 | final-shot-table | Final timing and camera table | 6 | Format: presentation document; at least eight actual pages. Stage: final. |

# Opening sequence records

## Timing and copy

| Shot ID | Start, seconds | End, seconds | Duration, seconds | Scale | Subject | State | Narrative action | Screen copy | Copy timing |
|---|---:|---:|---:|---|---|---|---|---|---|
| S01 | 0 | 3 | 3 | CU | Paper | Point | A compact paper point begins extending into a line. | None | None |
| S02 | 3 | 6 | 3 | CU | Paper | Line | The line opens laterally towards a plane. | None | None |
| S03 | 6 | 9 | 3 | MS | Paper | Plane | The plane exposes its crease and starts folding upwards. | None | None |
| S04 | 9 | 12 | 3 | MS | Paper | Volume | The folded volume becomes legible and starts reopening. | None | None |
| S05 | 12 | 15 | 3 | MS | Paper | Title reveal | The reopening volume develops into the final paper arrangement supporting the programme name. | FOLD INTO SCIENCE | Entrance at 12 seconds; fully readable by 14 seconds |
| S06 | 15 | 18 | 3 | WS | Paper | Title hold | The final paper arrangement and complete title composition hold. | FOLD INTO SCIENCE; Science takes shape | Tagline entrance at 15 seconds; both lines held through 18 seconds |

## Audio

- Spoken script: none

## Copy records
- Programme name: FOLD INTO SCIENCE
- Tagline: Science takes shape

steps.userMessage:
FOLD INTO SCIENCE | A paper transformation opening for a science programme

We are launching FOLD INTO SCIENCE, a general science programme for teenagers and curious adults watching on digital screens. Design the finished storyboard and key artwork for its 18-second opening: six shots in which a paper point becomes a line, opens into a plane, folds into a volume and unfolds to introduce the programme name. The theme words are Point, Line, Plane and Volume. The on-screen copy is "FOLD INTO SCIENCE" and "Science takes shape". The name begins appearing at 12 seconds and is fully readable by 14 seconds; the tagline appears at 15 seconds, followed by a three-second hold of the complete title composition.

The existing material is warm ivory, uncoated paper weighing 160 g/m², with a diagonal crease, visibly fibrous torn edges and a soft shadow cast towards the lower right. Carry these features through the transformations against a background of #263542. The particular silhouettes and transformation mechanisms are yours to develop. The opening has a 16:9 composition and a separately composed 9:16 version. Both use action margins of 3.5% and graphic margins of 5% on every edge. The final title group occupies the attached title area: 20–80% across and 58–82% down the landscape frame; 10–90% across and 55–78% down the portrait frame. Coordinates are measured from the top left.

Audience: the programme producer and motion designer, selecting the finished visual treatment and using its shot timings to build the opening for teenage and general audiences.

Inputs (attached): 01-client-facts.en.md records the programme identity, material, timing and composition facts. 02-delivery-catalog.en.md lists the deliverable proportions, formats and stages. 03-sequence-records.en.md contains the six timed narrative beats and exact screen copy. landscape-safe-areas.png supplies the landscape frame, safety margins and final title area. portrait-safe-areas.png supplies the portrait equivalents. opening-timeline.png locates the transformation beats, title entrance and final hold. ivory-paper-identity.png records the existing paper's crease, torn edge and shadow. sidelight-table-reference.png supplies the lighting atmosphere of an empty tabletop.

Deliverables:
1. One finished storyboard document containing six landscape panels and six corresponding portrait panels, numbered S01–S06 in each sequence, with shot ID, shot scale, duration in seconds and subject name Paper printed inside every panel
2. One paper transformation sheet containing the six shot states, five connecting transition studies and front, side and back views of the S04 volume, with arrows tracing the crease and a torn edge through each change
3. One finished landscape keyframe for S04 at 11 seconds, showing the folded volume, ivory paper texture and directional shadow
4. One finished landscape end frame for S06 at 16 seconds, with the programme name and tagline in their final composition
5. One finished portrait end frame for S06 at 16 seconds, with the same paper identity and copy in a composition developed for the portrait title area
6. One final shot table containing six rows, with shot ID, scale, subject, start and end times, duration, paper action, transition mechanism, camera movement, screen copy and text entrance timing

Acceptance:
- The storyboard and shot table contain S01–S06 in order, each lasting 3 seconds, for a total of 18 seconds; their scales match the sequence records: CU, CU, MS, MS, MS, WS, and each panel identifies Paper as its subject.
- The transformation sheet traces Point, Line, Plane, Volume, Title reveal and Title hold across its six states and five transitions; the storyboard depicts the same mechanisms, with the preceding paper edge or fold visibly carried into each following state.
- The transformation sheet, storyboard and three keyframes retain the 160 g/m² ivory paper's diagonal crease and fibrous torn edge wherever those surfaces face the viewer, with illumination from the upper left and shadows towards the lower right against #263542.
- The storyboard and shot table place the entrance of FOLD INTO SCIENCE at 12 seconds, complete its reveal by 14 seconds and introduce Science takes shape at 15 seconds; both end frames print those strings exactly and depict the composition held from 15 to 18 seconds.
- The twelve storyboard panels and three keyframes use their assigned 16:9 or 9:16 composition, with the paper subject inside the 3.5% action margins and text inside the 5% graphic margins; the two end frames place the complete title group within their respective title areas stated above.
- The portrait storyboard and portrait end frame reposition and rescale the paper and title for the portrait frame while preserving the six landscape beats; the S04 keyframe matches the storyboard's volume at 11 seconds, and both end frames retain the paper arrangement reached through S05.

Please clearly mark which version you consider the final deliverable. If nothing is marked, the last exported version counts.
